modes.name: Unknot
modes.movement: Reduce semantic friction without chasing optimality.

exercises.title: One branch less
exercises.invitation: Change only what makes the control flow easier to hold. Preserving behavior is enough. One rename or one early return may be the whole exercise.
exercises.exit: Stop after the first reduction in semantic friction.

exercises.title: Release the temporary
exercises.invitation: Look for a value whose name exists only because the expression was split. Keep it if the name carries meaning; release it if it does not.
exercises.material:
def visible_names(users):
    active_users = [user for user in users if user.active]
    names = [user.name for user in active_users]
    return names
exercises.exit: Either keeping or removing the temporary is a valid result when the reason is clear.

modes.name: Fold
modes.movement: Compress prose into facts, invariants, and unknowns.

exercises.title: Policy into three shapes
exercises.invitation: Fold the paragraph into exactly three headings: Facts, Invariants, Unknowns. Do not solve the unknowns.
exercises.material: The export probably runs every night, although the schedule may have changed. Existing customers must never lose records. The new endpoint should feel fast, but no latency target has been agreed. Finance believes deleted accounts should remain in historical totals.
exercises.exit: Stop when every sentence has one epistemic home.

exercises.title: Keep only decision-changing context
exercises.invitation: Compress this note until every remaining sentence could change implementation or validation.
exercises.material: The service began as an internal prototype three years ago. Many teams have discussed replacing it. Today it receives JSON, rejects payloads above 1 MB, and must preserve the current error codes. The office moved last spring.
exercises.exit: Discarded context does not need to be criticized.

exercises.title: Three letters carrying a policy
exercises.invitation: Rename only the parameters. Let the new names reveal the policy without adding comments.
exercises.exit: Stop when the call site could be read without surrounding prose.

exercises.title: A boolean with two lives
exercises.invitation: The flag means both data availability and permission. Find a name or representation that refuses the ambiguity.
exercises.exit: A clearly stated unresolved split is also a valid result.

modes.name: Drift
modes.movement: Explore distinct forms without selecting a winner.

exercises.title: Three shapes of uniqueness
exercises.invitation: Express this operation in three genuinely different forms: declarative, stateful, and streaming. Do not rank them.
exercises.material: Return the first occurrence of each tag while preserving input order.
exercises.exit: Stop after the forms reveal different tradeoffs.

exercises.title: Retry as policy
exercises.invitation: Represent a three-attempt retry policy as data, control flow, and a composable abstraction. No form needs to win.
exercises.material: Retry transient failures at 100 ms, 300 ms, and 900 ms. Permanent failures stop immediately.
exercises.exit: Keep the differences; convergence is not required.

exercises.title: The invisible ordering
exercises.invitation: Do not rewrite the algorithm. Name the smallest assumption that decides whether it is trustworthy, then make that assumption observable.
exercises.material:
def contains(values, target):
    lo, hi = 0, len(values) - 1
    while lo <= hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if values[mid] == target: return True
        if values[mid] < target: lo = mid + 1
        else: hi = mid - 1
    return False
exercises.exit: Stop once the hidden precondition has a visible boundary.

exercises.title: Time inside a cache
exercises.invitation: Find the one assumption about time that can make this cache lie. Prefer exposing it over redesigning everything.
exercises.exit: A precise failure story is enough.

exercises.title: A boundary held twice
exercises.invitation: Do not improve this expression. Observe which invariant survives every input and describe it in one sentence, or remain silent.
exercises.material:
const between = (low, high) =>
  (value) => Math.min(high, Math.max(low, value));

exercises.title: The quiet base case
exercises.invitation: Read the function once. Notice where recursion gives way to a value. Modification is optional.
exercises.exit: Leave when the shape is clear enough.
